description: PROC GLMSELECT SELECTION=STEPWISE -> statsmodels-based forward/backward selection mirroring SAS SLENTRY/SLSTAY or CHOOSE=SBC/AIC.

glmselect_stepwise.title: SELECTION=STEPWISE -> implement forward/backward selection with statsmodels; the selected variable set is the primary QC target.
rule: Stepwise selection adds/removes predictors by a criterion (SL, SBC, AIC); SAS controls entry/stay with `SLENTRY=`/`SLSTAY=` or `SELECT=`/`CHOOSE=`.
scikit-learn has no exact stepwise -- use `statsmodels` and implement forward/backward selection by p-value or information criterion to mirror SAS.
Reproduce the SAS criterion exactly: significance-level stepwise adds if p < SLENTRY and drops if p > SLSTAY; `CHOOSE=SBC`/`AIC` picks the step minimizing that criterion.
`OUTEST=` holds the final coefficients; the **selected variable set** is the primary QC target, then the estimates within tolerance.
pitfalls: Chasing exact betas instead of the selected-variable set; parity on the chosen predictors matters more.
Mismatching the entry/stay criterion (p-value vs SBC/AIC) yields a different final model.
